product.title: Ultimate Sedona Jeep Tour: Vortex, Landmarks & Scenic Views

description.text: Sedona's longest signature Jeep tour packs vortex sites, landmark stops, and shopping time into five and a half hours of guided red rock exploration. Visit Chapel of the Holy Cross, Airport Mesa, Amitabha Stupa and Peace Park, Lover's Knoll, and Tlaquepaque Arts & Shopping Village while your driver narrates geology, Native history, and Sedona's spiritual reputation. The route balances mild off-road segments with cultural stops so you see natural formations and local craft galleries in one comprehensive day. This is the operator's most complete Jeep itinerary for travelers who want breadth rather than a single-theme vortex or canyon ride. Morning departures include time for lunch near Tlaquepaque; bring sun protection for open-air Jeep seating.

highlights: Chapel of the Holy Cross and Airport Mesa vortex stops
Amitabha Stupa and Peace Park visit included
Free time at Tlaquepaque Arts & Shopping Village
Lover's Knoll scenic viewpoint on the red rock loop
